verses.original: גֶּ֤פֶן בּוֹקֵק֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל פְּרִ֖י יְשַׁוֶּה־ לּ֑וֹ כְּרֹ֣ב לְפִרְי֗וֹ הִרְבָּה֙ לַֽמִּזְבְּח֔וֹת כְּט֣וֹב לְאַרְצ֔וֹ הֵיטִ֖יבוּ מַצֵּבֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ge·p̄en bō·w·qêq yiś·rā·’êl pə·rî yə·šaw·weh- lōw kə·rōḇ lə·p̄ir·yōw hir·bāh lam·miz·bə·ḥō·wṯ kə·ṭō·wḇ lə·’ar·ṣōw hê·ṭî·ḇū maṣ·ṣê·ḇō·wṯ
verses.literal: Israel was a luxuriant vine yielding fruit for himself The more his fruit increased the more he increased the altars The better his land produced the better he made the sacred pillars

verses.original: חָלַ֥ק לִבָּ֖ם עַתָּ֣ה יֶאְשָׁ֑מוּ ה֚וּא יַעֲרֹ֣ף מִזְבְּחוֹתָ֔ם יְשֹׁדֵ֖ד מַצֵּבוֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ḥā·laq lib·bām ‘at·tāh ye’·šā·mū hū ya·‘ă·rōp̄ miz·bə·ḥō·w·ṯām yə·šō·ḏêḏ maṣ·ṣê·ḇō·w·ṯām
verses.literal: Their hearts are devious now they must bear their guilt The LORD will break down their altars and demolish their sacred pillars

verses.original: כִּ֤י עַתָּה֙ יֹֽאמְר֔וּ אֵ֥ין מֶ֖לֶךְ לָ֑נוּ כִּ֣י לֹ֤א יָרֵ֙אנוּ֙ אֶת־ יְהֹוָ֔ה וְהַמֶּ֖לֶךְ מַה־ יַּֽעֲשֶׂה־ לָּֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ‘at·tāh yō·mə·rū ’ên me·leḵ lā·nū kî lō yā·rê·nū ’eṯ- ha·šēm wə·ham·me·leḵ mah- ya·‘ă·śeh- lā·nū
verses.literal: Surely now they will say We have no king for we do not revere the LORD What can a king do for us

verses.original: דִּבְּר֣וּ דְבָרִ֔ים אָל֥וֹת שָׁ֖וְא כָּרֹ֣ת בְּרִ֑ית וּפָרַ֤ח כָּרֹאשׁ֙ מִשְׁפָּ֔ט עַ֖ל תַּלְמֵ֥י שָׂדָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: dib·bə·rū ḏə·ḇā·rîm ’ā·lō·wṯ šāw kā·rōṯ bə·rîṯ ū·p̄ā·raḥ kā·rōš miš·pāṭ ‘al tal·mê śā·ḏāy
verses.literal: They speak mere words with false oaths they make covenants So judgment springs up like poisonous weeds in the furrows of a field

verses.original: לְעֶגְלוֹת֙ בֵּ֣ית אָ֔וֶן יָג֖וּרוּ שְׁכַ֣ן שֹֽׁמְר֑וֹן כִּי־ אָבַ֨ל עָלָ֜יו עַמּ֗וֹ וּכְמָרָיו֙ עָלָ֣יו יָגִ֔ילוּ עַל־ כְּבוֹד֖וֹ כִּֽי־ גָלָ֥ה מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: lə·‘eḡ·lō·wṯ bêṯ ’ā·wen yā·ḡū·rū šə·ḵan šō·mə·rō·wn kî- ’ā·ḇal ‘ā·lāw ‘am·mōw ū·ḵə·mā·rāw ‘ā·lāw yā·ḡî·lū ‘al- kə·ḇō·w·ḏōw kî- ḡā·lāh mim·men·nū
verses.literal: The people of Samaria will fear for the calf of Beth-aven Indeed its people will mourn over it with its idolatrous priests those who rejoiced in its glory for it has been taken from them into exile

verses.original: גַּם־ אוֹתוֹ֙ לְאַשּׁ֣וּר יוּבָ֔ל מִנְחָ֖ה לְמֶ֣לֶךְ יָרֵ֑ב בָּשְׁנָה֙ אֶפְרַ֣יִם יִקָּ֔ח וְיֵב֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מֵעֲצָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: gam- ’ō·w·ṯōw lə·’aš·šūr yū·ḇāl min·ḥāh lə·me·leḵ yā·rêḇ bā·šə·nāh ’ep̄·ra·yim yiq·qāḥ wə·yê·ḇō·wōš yiś·rā·’êl mê·‘ă·ṣā·ṯōw
verses.literal: Yes it will be carried to Assyria as tribute to the great king Ephraim will be seized with shame Israel will be ashamed of its wooden idols

verses.original: נִדְמֶ֥ה שֹׁמְר֖וֹן מַלְכָּ֑הּ כְּקֶ֖צֶף עַל־ פְּנֵי־ מָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: niḏ·meh šō·mə·rō·wn mal·kāh kə·qe·ṣep̄ ‘al- pə·nê- mā·yim
verses.literal: Samaria will be carried off with her king like a twig on the surface of the water

verses.original: וְנִשְׁמְד֞וּ בָּמ֣וֹת אָ֗וֶן חַטַּאת֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל ק֣וֹץ וְדַרְדַּ֔ר יַעֲלֶ֖ה עַל־ מִזְבְּחוֹתָ֑ם וְאָמְר֤וּ לֶֽהָרִים֙ כַּסּ֔וּנוּ וְלַגְּבָע֖וֹת נִפְל֥וּ עָלֵֽינוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·niš·mə·ḏū bā·mō·wṯ ’ā·wen ḥaṭ·ṭaṯ yiś·rā·’êl qō·wṣ wə·ḏar·dar ya·‘ă·leh ‘al- miz·bə·ḥō·w·ṯām wə·’ā·mə·rū le·hā·rîm kas·sū·nū wə·lag·gə·ḇā·‘ō·wṯ nip̄·lū ‘ā·lê·nū
verses.literal: The high places of Aven will be destroyed it is the sin of Israel thorns and thistles will overgrow . . . their altars Then they will say to the mountains Cover us and to the hills Fall on us

verses.original: מִימֵי֙ הַגִּבְעָ֔ה חָטָ֖אתָ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל שָׁ֣ם עָמָ֔דוּ לֹֽא־ תַשִּׂיגֵ֧ם בַּגִּבְעָ֛ה מִלְחָמָ֖ה עַל־ בְּנֵ֥י עַֽלְוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: mî·mê hag·giḇ·‘āh ḥā·ṭā·ṯā yiś·rā·’êl šām ‘ā·mā·ḏū lō- ṯaś·śî·ḡêm bag·giḇ·‘āh mil·ḥā·māh ‘al- bə·nê ‘al·wāh
verses.literal: Since the days of Gibeah you have sinned O Israel and there you have remained Did not the battle in Gibeah overtake the sons of iniquity

verses.original: בְּאַוָּתִ֖י וְאֶסֳּרֵ֑ם וְאֻסְּפ֤וּ עֲלֵיהֶם֙ עַמִּ֔ים בְּאָסְרָ֖ם לִשְׁתֵּ֥י עֵינֹתָם׃
verses.transliteration: bə·’aw·wā·ṯî wə·’es·so·rêm wə·’us·sə·p̄ū ‘ă·lê·hem ‘am·mîm bə·’ā·sə·rām liš·tê ʿē·nō·ṯå̄m
verses.literal: I will chasten them when I please nations will be gathered against them to put them in bondage for their double transgression

verses.original: וְאֶפְרַ֜יִם עֶגְלָ֤ה מְלֻמָּדָה֙ אֹהַ֣בְתִּי לָד֔וּשׁ וַאֲנִ֣י עָבַ֔רְתִּי עַל־ ט֖וּב צַוָּארָ֑הּ אַרְכִּ֤יב אֶפְרַ֙יִם֙ יַחֲר֣וֹשׁ יְהוּדָ֔ה יְשַׂדֶּד־ ל֖וֹ יַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ep̄·ra·yim ‘eḡ·lāh mə·lum·mā·ḏāh ’ō·haḇ·tî lā·ḏūš wa·’ă·nî ‘ā·ḇar·tî ‘al- ṭūḇ ṣaw·wā·rāh ’ar·kîḇ ’ep̄·ra·yim ya·ḥă·rō·wōš yə·hū·ḏāh yə·śad·deḏ- lōw ya·‘ă·qōḇ
verses.literal: Ephraim is a well-trained heifer that loves to thresh but I will place a yoke on her fair neck I will harness Ephraim Judah will plow and Jacob will break the hard ground

verses.original: זִרְע֨וּ לָכֶ֤ם לִצְדָקָה֙ קִצְר֣וּ לְפִי־ חֶ֔סֶד נִ֥ירוּ לָכֶ֖ם נִ֑יר וְעֵת֙ לִדְר֣וֹשׁ אֶת־ יְהוָ֔ה עַד־ יָב֕וֹא וְיֹרֶ֥ה צֶ֖דֶק לָכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: zir·‘ū lā·ḵem liṣ·ḏā·qāh qiṣ·rū lə·p̄î- ḥe·seḏ nî·rū lā·ḵem nîr wə·‘êṯ liḏ·rō·wōš ’eṯ- Yah·weh ‘aḏ- yā·ḇō·w wə·yō·reh ṣe·ḏeq lā·ḵem
verses.literal: Sow for yourselves righteousness and reap the fruit . . . of loving devotion break up your unplowed ground For it is time to seek the LORD until He comes and sends righteousness upon you like rain

verses.original: חֲרַשְׁתֶּם־ רֶ֛שַׁע עַוְלָ֥תָה קְצַרְתֶּ֖ם אֲכַלְתֶּ֣ם פְּרִי־ כָ֑חַשׁ כִּֽי־ בָטַ֥חְתָּ בְדַרְכְּךָ֖ בְּרֹ֥ב גִּבּוֹרֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ḥă·raš·tem- re·ša‘ ‘aw·lā·ṯāh qə·ṣar·tem ’ă·ḵal·tem pə·rî- ḵā·ḥaš kî- ḇā·ṭaḥ·tā ḇə·ḏar·kə·ḵā bə·rōḇ gib·bō·w·re·ḵā
verses.literal: You have plowed wickedness and reaped injustice you have eaten the fruit of lies Because you have trusted in your own way and in the multitude of your mighty men

verses.original: וְקָ֣אם שָׁאוֹן֮ בְּעַמֶּךָ֒ וְכָל־ מִבְצָרֶ֣יךָ יוּשַּׁ֔ד כְּשֹׁ֧ד שַֽׁלְמַ֛ן בֵּ֥ית אַֽרְבֵ֖אל בְּי֣וֹם מִלְחָמָ֑ה אֵ֥ם עַל־ בָּנִ֖ים רֻטָּֽשָׁה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·qām šā·’ō·wn bə·‘am·me·ḵā wə·ḵāl miḇ·ṣā·re·ḵā yūš·šaḏ kə·šōḏ šal·man bêṯ ’ar·ḇêl bə·yō·wm mil·ḥā·māh ’êm ‘al- bā·nîm ruṭ·ṭā·šāh
verses.literal: the roar of battle will rise against your people so that all your fortresses will be demolished as Shalman devastated Beth-arbel in the day of battle when mothers were dashed to pieces along with their children

verses.original: כָּ֗כָה עָשָׂ֤ה לָכֶם֙ בֵּֽית־ אֵ֔ל מִפְּנֵ֖י רָעַ֣ת רָֽעַתְכֶ֑ם בַּשַּׁ֕חַר נִדְמֹ֥ה נִדְמָ֖ה מֶ֥לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: kā·ḵāh ‘ā·śāh lā·ḵem bêṯ- ’êl mip·pə·nê rā·‘aṯ rā·‘aṯ·ḵem baš·ša·ḥar niḏ·mōh niḏ·māh me·leḵ yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Thus it will be done to you O Bethel because of your great wickedness When the day dawns the king of Israel will be utterly cut off . . .
